# AWS Cost Optimizer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > AWS

## Overview

Optimizes AWS costs with reserved instances, savings plans, right-sizing, and resource cleanup for cloud financial management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [aws-cost-optimizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
aws-cost-optimizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@aws-cost-optimizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze costs with AWS Cost Explorer
- Recommend reserved instances and savings plans
- Identify underutilized resources for right-sizing
- Detect unused resources for cleanup

## Technology Standards Applied

- **AWS Cost Optimization**: Cost reduction best practices
- **Reserved Instances**: RI and savings plan selection
- **Right-Sizing**: Instance type optimization guidelines
